results.content: Methods: This one-year retrospective analysis was conducted at the laboratory of a tertiary care hospital and included information on blood samples that were taken for hematology tests from both outpatients and inpatients. The preanalytical variables identified in this study that can affect the test results were sample in inappropriate collection tube, clotted blood sample, insufficient sample, hemolyzed sample, diluted sample, excess sample, empty vacutainer/damaged tube, wrong label, and delay in transfer to laboratory.
